text:

CET 04:53 AM

Globally recognized Independent Designer and Creative Director
based in the Netherlands. Working at the intersection of design,
art, and photography with a host of international clients that
includes the J. Paul Getty Museum, Frank O. Gehry and
Partners, The Obama Foundation, Gates Foundation, Delta
Airlines, Adobe, Meta, Adidas, VanMoof, Lexus, Toyota,
Samsung, Ecco®, Joby, and more.
